newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Paraguay president faints from Bogota altitude.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay president faints from Bogota altitude.

text.p: Paraguayan President Juan Carlos Wasmosy fainted, apparently from the effects of altitude, at the start of an official visit to Colombia on Wednesday.

Wasmosy collapsed as he was receiving the keys to the capital from Bogota Mayor Paul Bromberg. Bogota lies in the eastern range of the Andes mountains at an altitude of about 8,500 feet (2,600 metres).

The Paraguayan president, in Colombia for two days, was given oxygen and taken to a hotel in downtown Bogota to rest, cancelling a scheduled trip to Congress. Sources at City Hall said Wasmosy complained of suffering altitude sickness.
During his visit, the Paraguayan head of state aims to sign a series agreements on bilateral legal cooperation and draw up joint action against money laundering and drug trafficking.
